name: Empty Clips
description: Create an empty MIDI clip in the first empty slot on each ticked MIDI track.

fields.label: Length in beats
fields.hint: Number of beats (quarter notes). 4 = 1 bar in 4/4 time, 8 = 2 bars, etc.

fields.label: Clip name
fields.hint: The name given to each newly created empty MIDI clip.
